messages:
Priya (customer): Hi team, we're seeing streaming responses cut off after ~90s. Client receives a chunk with truncated text and then connection dies. No 4xx/5xx from server, client just reports ECONNRESET. This started after we put Cloudflare in front.
Omar (support): Sorry you're hitting this. Can you confirm whether the last bytes include a SSE comment ping or final newline? Also does the client reconnect immediately or wait? Any last-event-id used?
Priya (customer): We use last-event-id to dedupe but our reconnect logic assumes the stream ended normally if we get no more bytes. We saw repeated duplicated tokens on billing. Logs: client shows receiving `:hb\n\n` at 30s, 60s, 90s, then at 92s RST from CF IP. The partial payload ends with `...model says the answer is 42 and the best way to proceed is to` then nothing.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Two vectors here: (A) Cloud providers/proxies sometimes kill idle HTTP streams because they think the connection is hanging — but you said comment pings arrive, which contradicts. (B) TLS session renegotiation / ticket reissue issues can cause upstream proxies to reset downstream TCP if they don't support 0-RTT/ticket resumption well. Did you upgrade TLS config or change CF settings recently?
Priya (customer): We didn't change TLS. We only added Cloudflare and enabled their WAF.
Mei (eng-sre): We had a similar case where CF's edge prematurely terminated long streaming backend connections when WAF rules triggered subtle buffering behavior. If Cloudflare buffers response bodies (for scanning) then it may hold bytes and enforce an internal idle timeout, causing a reset even though server wrote keepalives.
Omar (support): Can you reproduce with a direct curl to our origin (bypass CF)? Try: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://origin.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=..."` and also try `curl --http2` to test HTTP/2 behavior.
Priya (customer): Reproduced to origin — origin stays open for 5+ minutes with steady `:hb` comments, no reset. Through Cloudflare it resets at ~92s consistently. tcpdump at client shows comment pings make it to client. RST shows source IP of CF edge.
Ravi (eng-runtime): This suggests Cloudflare edge is deciding to RST. Two mitigations: (1) switch ping format to smaller single-line bytes that avoid WAF buffer triggers; (2) emit small chunked JSON partial tokens every 15s (non-SSE comment) i.e. send a tiny data chunk `{ "meta": "tick" }\n` so proxies see application data and don't treat stream as idle. We should be careful not to break SSE parser though.
Mei (eng-sre): Also check CF "Response buffering" and "Chunked transfer" settings. If CF enables "Buffering for caching/WAF", it may wait for more data and then time out before forwarding. Recommend customer set CF Page Rule to disable buffering or bypass WAF for the endpoint during testing.
Priya (customer): Quick question on billing: we got charged for duplicated responses when client retried. Any way to get credits?
Omar (support): I'll open a billing ticket and tag it as potential duplication due to infra proxy resets. For immediate relief we can apply a small credit to offset obvious duplication while we investigate; billing-bot will handle the request.
billing-bot: Billing case created BC-2026-339. Estimated review 48h.
Ravi (eng-runtime): Internally I'll prototype a heartbeat mode that emits raw single-byte keepalive frames (non-comment) or toggles Content-Type to a chunked-text/event-stream-safe keepalive with no blank-line terminator so buggy parsers and proxies have less chance to interpret as event termination. We must ensure we remain SSE-spec compliant; I'll put an opt-in header `X-Redwood-Stream-Keep: proxy-friendly` for customers behind known proxies.
Mei (eng-sre): I'll reach out to Cloudflare support with packet traces. Also we'll document recommended CF settings and advise customers to disable certain WAF features for streaming endpoints.
Priya (customer): I'll try the bypass rule and report back. Also we can test the runtime opt-in if you expose it.
Omar (support): Action items: 
- Priya: test bypassing CF and post results + pcap (client tcpdump).
- Mei: open CF support ticket and check edge config logs.
- Ravi: spike a proxy-friendly keepalive option and safety tests (SSE parsers).
- Omar: open billing adjustment request (BC-2026-339).
Mei (eng-sre): FYI, if CF is RSTing then increasing origin response frequency won't help until CF is configured correctly. But adding small visible chunks (not purely comment lines) tends to keep proxy eyes open.
Priya (customer): Bypassed CF rule, stream stayed up beyond 10 minutes. With CF enabled, still dies at ~92s. Sending pcap now. Thanks everyone.
Omar (support): Thanks Priya. Marking as escalated to eng-runtime + eng-sre. We'll follow up when CF responds. :pray:
